name: commune_successions
title: Commune code successions
description: For an old INSEE code, the code that follows it, the kind of change and its date.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the row, never reused. It is the target of the foreign keys of an application.

fields.name: from_code
fields.description: INSEE code of the commune that changes or disappears.

fields.name: to_code
fields.description: INSEE code that follows it. Empty when the commune disappears without a successor.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: absorbed, code_reused, deleted, renamed, replaced or split.

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: Date of effect of the change (YYYY-MM-DD).
